tei:div.tei:p: "$ (241)༄༅// sngon 'gro'i khrid yig thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor du bya ba bzhugs so//

(242)༄༅// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dben pa bsten zhing sgrub pa la snying por byed pa rnams kyis thun bzhir rnal 'byor du bya ba'i rim pa la/ dang por le lo bzlog phyir mi rtag pa la sogs pa bsam pa na/ lus bsam gtan gyi chos bdun dang ldan par 'dug te/ kye ma/ dal 'byor mi lus yang yang rnyed par dka'// lan cig rnyed pa'ang mi rtag 'chi bar nges// tshe 'di'i mdza' bshes tshogs 'dus mi bzhin 'gyes// nor rdzas sbrang rtsi lta bur gzhan gyis spyod// dpal 'byor snyan grags nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon bzhin// nam 'chi cha med blo bur rkyen gyis 'jig /shi nas nges pa med par las dbang 'khyams// ngan 'gror ltung ba'i sdug bsngal bzod thabs med// bde 'gror skyes kyang sdug bsngal kho na'i ngang*// de bas 'khor ba 'di la skyo shas skyes// bde chen byang chub sgrub dus da res yin// tshe la longs med sgrub la brtson 'grus bya// zhes dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang mi rtag pa la sogs pa bsams te yid phyung dge sbyor la bskul ma (243)gdab par bya'o/ ༈ /de nas bar chad sel phyir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de/ gnas de nyid 'og min la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam dag tu mos pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma dang jo bo dkon mchog gsum dang yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dpag du med pas bskor bar bzhugs par mos nas/ mar gyur sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor sdug bsngal bar gyur pa snying re rje/ 'di rnams sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god par bya// de'i phyir du skyabs yul rnams la lam sna 'dren zhing bar chad sel ba'i don du skyabs su 'gro snyam du bsams la/ bdag gzhan nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus bzang po 'di nas bzung snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/

phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa (244)bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la= yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la= dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus brjod nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// byang chub sems su 'di bgyis te// bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrub phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// e ma'o sems can kun 'gron gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog mdzad bzhin spyad// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas shog /ces lan gsum gyis bdun rnam dag bya// sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar= sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar= nye ring chags sdang gnyis dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig /ces lan gsum gyis tshad med bzhi bsgom mo/ ༈ /de nas tshogs bsags phyir maṇ+ḍal dbul ba ni// sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal zhes bya ba tshogs bsags pa'i zhing du slar yang sngar gyi skyabs yul rnams gsal bar dmigs te/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa 'byor na dngos su bkod la/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri'i khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su/

hūm̐ ri'i (245)rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po// lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ byang shar du zla ba/ lho nub tu nyi ma/ dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa mtha' yas pa sprul te// bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyongs srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sa gzhi spos kyis phyugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// dus gsum bde gshegs dgongs pa rtog pa dang*// srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas shing*// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog /oṃ maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐// zhes maṇ+ḍal phul nas// bla ma dang ni 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams la// sgo gsum dang bas zhabs la phyag bgyi'o// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul nas mchod cing bstod// sngon byas sdig pa ma lus so sor bshags// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// 'gro ba kun gyi dge la rjes yi rang*// theg mchog chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge ba 'di yis nye bar mtshon pa yi// skye 'phags dag gi dus gsum dge tshogs rnams// bla med byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi// 'gro kun rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob gyur cig /byams dang snying rje phyogs med 'byongs pa dang*// don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de// rgyal ba (246)sras bcas rnams kyis rtogs pa ltar// bdag gis mngon sum rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes yan lag bdun pa byas te gsol ba btab la tshogs zhing rnams rang la bsdu ba'am mi dmigs par bya'o/

༈ /de nas sgrib pa sbyang phyir rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang tha mal pa'i spyi bor pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim de 'od du zhu yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/ gnyis ka'ang mtshan dpes spras shing rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āḥthugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ zhes mos te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po'i mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng dkar pos 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i de (247)bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi spyi bo nas zhugs thugs kar thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ sbyor mtshams dang zhabs kyi sor mo nas byung ba rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te lus thams cad gang*/

nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir zags pas lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bu gsal zhing dri ma med par gyur/ zhes mos shing*/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karmā su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñca/ he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa lan nyer gcig sogs ci nus dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang ci nus brjod la/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi /dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol bas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag pa yin no zhes gsung zhing 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med par gyur// zhes mos so/ ༈ /de nas byin rlabs 'jug phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor sgom (248)pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥs bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/

'gro don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa la/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig spyan gsum pa mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ skra mtshams su rdo rje'i phreng bas sprel ba'i thod skam rin po che'i rtse bran can lngas brgyan zhing ral pa'i cod pan gyi rtse mor nor bu mdun du sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon du zla ba phyed pas spras pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud la/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed kyi mgo bo blta ba ste brdzis shing g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan gyi nu bar du mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol zhing thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan zhing gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra sil bu grol ba'i mtshams su thod pa skam po lngas sgras pa/ phyag gnyis kyis g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul la 'khyud de stob cing g.yas sdig mdzub dang bcas pas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khril ba/ bde ba chen po'i nyams kyis sgeg cing lang tshos mdzes pa/ gcer mo thod skam lnga bcu'i do shal dang rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gnyis ga'ang mtshan dpes spras shing bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ thabs shes gnyis su med par snyoms par 'jug (249)pa/ de'i dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur/ pheṃ zhes pa'i sgra dang snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dza/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥdam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ zhes rang bde mchog lhan skyes su bsgom pa'am/ gzhan yang yi dam gyi lha gang yin rer bsgoms la/

rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la/ ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngo sangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu bsnol thabs su 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang du yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma sngon mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras shing rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bzas mdzes shing 'od kyi gur khang na bzhugs pa/ zhing khams thams cad sku la rdzogs shing snang la rang bzhin med pa/ bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas bla ma sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du gyur// zhes mos nas/ sku gsum (250)yongs rdzogs bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid kyis mchod// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid yongs bzhes nas// bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes sogs dngos su 'byor pa dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa mtha' yas pa phul te/ snying khung rus pa'i gting nas mchi ma 'khrugs shing g.yo ba tsam du 'khor ba la skyo shas thar pa la nges 'byung bla ma la mos gus kyi shugs tshad med pa bskyed la gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ bla ma 'od gsal chos sku la gsol ba 'debs so// bla ma bde chen longs sku la=

/bla ma thugs rje sprul sku la= /bla ma sku gsum dbyer med la= /bla ma sku bzhi'i bdag nyid la= /bla ma sku lnga yongs rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs so// zhes dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// sgyu lus sprul skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung la= /srog rtsol longs skur rtogs par = /dpal ldan bla ma'i thugs la= /sems nyid chos skur rtogs par= /chos chos su 'gro bar= /chos lam du longs par= /lam gyi 'khrul pa sel bar= /'khrul pa ye shes su 'char bar= /gtum mo sgyu lus grub par= /rmi lam 'od gsal zin par= /bar do 'pho ba 'byongs par= /tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob par byin= /zhes rtse gcig tu gsol ba gdab/ spro na bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyang bya'o// de nas ting 'dzin gyi dbang blang ba ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas dpal ldan bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi dpral bar thim bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub par byas/ bla ma'i mgrin (251)pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ lam rang byin gyis brlab kyi rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang 'bras bu longs sku 'grub par byas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob yid kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ lam phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang 'bras bu chos sku 'grub par byas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim dbang bzhi pa thob lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa'i bag chags sbyangs/ lam bden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub par byas/

zhes mos/ 'di'i phan yon dang dgos pa dpag tu med par yod par bshad pas rtag tu ci nus bya/ de nas dpal ldan bla ma 'khor bcas dgyes shing brtse ba chen pos 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang dpal ldan bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ zhes mos la sems ma bcos par rang lugs su glod nas rig pa gsal sing nge ba la ngos bzung med pa'i ngang du ci nus mnyam par bzhag ༈ /de nas bskyed rim la gtso bor gzhol bas yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa dang sngags bzla ba sogs bya/ spros bcas kyi rdzogs rim la gzhol bas gtum mo la sogs pa'i dmigs rim bsgom/ spros med la gzhol bas phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag la/ thun las ldang ba'i tshe/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las (252)'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces sogs bsngo bas rgyas btab ste kha na ma tho ba med par gtor ma'i rim pa la sogs thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o// de ltar sgrub pa la yid gzhol bdag gis nges don phyag rgya chen po dang zab lam chos drug gi khrid la sogs pa'i sngon du 'gro zhing thun bzhir rnal 'byor du bya ba'i rim pa 'di yang bu slob 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba la brten nas sgam po la maṅga'i ming can gyis dpal sgam po'i sgrub sder bris pa dge legs su gyur cig// /
